title: 武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团官网正式上线发布
excerpt: 为进一步规范社团运营、全面展示社团风采，武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团已将海量社团信息进行数字化整合与公开化呈现。社团官方网站于2026年6月22日（今日）正式对外发布！（点击查看详情）
content:
为进一步规范社团运营、全面展示社团风采，武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团已将海量社团信息进行数字化整合与公开化呈现。社团官方网站于2026年6月22日（今日）正式对外发布！

武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团官方网站
网址：https://yglalpavir.github.io/wfls-tt-club

在官网中，您可自由查询并获取我社最新动态、社团简介、各类赛事信息及乒乓球个人分等数据。我们将持续更新官网，不断带来最新资讯，并持续优化网站功能与体验。欢迎广大师生访问浏览，并提出宝贵意见！

官网上线顺应当前教育信息化与信息科技发展潮流，标志着社团运营迈入数智化、信息化的新阶段，将有效提升我社的影响力与服务能力。

欢迎访问武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团官方网站！

武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团
2026年6月22日
title_en: WFLS Table Tennis Club Website Officially Launches
excerpt_en: To bring the club's operations up to standard and show its full character, the WFLS Table Tennis Club has integrated a large amount of club information in digital form and published it openly. The official club website was launched on 22 June 2026 (today)! (click for details)
content_en:
To bring the club's operations up to standard and show its full character, the WFLS Table Tennis Club has integrated a large amount of club information in digital form and published it openly. The official club website was launched on 22 June 2026 (today)!

WFLS Table Tennis Club official website
Address: https://yglalpavir.github.io/wfls-tt-club

On the website you can freely look up and retrieve our latest news, the club profile, information on all kinds of tournaments, and individual table tennis points, and much more. We will keep updating the site with the latest information and keep improving its features and experience. All teachers and students are welcome to visit and browse, and to share your valuable suggestions!

The website's launch follows the current trend of educational informatisation and information technology. It marks the club's operations entering a new stage of digital and intelligent management, and will effectively raise our influence and our ability to serve members.

Welcome to the official website of the WFLS Table Tennis Club!

WFLS Table Tennis Club
22 June 2026
